summary.text: Michael Veloff, a Libertarian writer and editor and an Ohio State University at Mansfield graduate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Ohio's 5th District to Bob Latta.
In his Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a lifelong Ohio resident and said he has been on Vermin Supreme's campaign staff since 2020.

paragraphs.text: Veloff earned a high school diploma from Malabar High School and a bachelor's degree in English literature from The Ohio State University at Mansfield (2001). Ballotpedia lists his career experience as writer/editor.
He describes himself as disabled and as having worked part time for nine years as a moderator for a cryptocurrency, and says he has been on Vermin Supreme's campaign staff since 2020.
He received 3.2% of the vote to Bob Latta's 54.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
